category_edits.rationale: Scale each input embedding by 1 + 0.1*log(1 + min(c, 9)), where c counts earlier occurrences of that item in the retained causal prefix. This fixed repeat-frequency feature preserves embedding parameters, GRU topology, readout, loss and optimizer. The generated predictor imports the updated model class, so training and inference use identical features.
